{{Quote|Her sacrifice gave Onderon its freedom.|[[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]]|<ref name="Tipping Points" />}}
'''Steela Gerrera''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the younger sister of [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]]. She lived on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and served as a bold leader of the rebel group that fought against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|occupation]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==

===Early Life===
Steela Gerrera was a young<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> female [[Human/Legends|Human]] native<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and lived during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> She had a brother named [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]]<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> and they lived originally at [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name=":1">{{SWE|characters|sawgerrera|Saw Gerrera}}</ref> As a sister, Steela knew him the most and could easily cut through his bluster with a well-timed and affectionate jibe.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

===Figthing for Onderon===

====Early figths against Rash====
[[File:LuxSteela-TSW.png|thumb|250x250px|Steela prepearing plans alongside [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]].]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] took control of Onderon<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> after a local coup<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date">{{FactFile2014|44|20 BBY 43-46|Liberation of Onderon}}</ref> that saw [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] taking the throne as the new king.<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> The [[Onderonian/Legends|people]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], though, began to reject Rash's rule,<ref name=":4">{{SWE|characters|general-tandin|General Tandin}}</ref> as they preferred the neutral stance championed by former monarch [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]].<ref name=":5">{{SWE|locations|onderon|Onderon}}</ref> An [[Onderon rebels/Legends|insurgency]] began targeting the battle droid forces stationed on the planet, refusing to acknowledge the legitimacy of Rash's rule.<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> 

The rebels, made up by outcasts<ref name="SWE-Onderon rebels">{{SWE|groups|onderonrebels|Onderon rebels}}</ref> and patriots,<ref name="SWE-dalgo">{{SWE|characters|dalgo|dalgo}}</ref> eventually included Steela and his brother Saw,<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> who were cast out of the walled city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] and forced to live in ruins amid the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Steela eventually became friend of [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]],<ref name=":1" /> returned to Onderon<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> to free his homeworld from King [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]]'s Separatist-backed regime,<ref name="SW-A War on Two Fronts - The Clone Wars Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep502|text="A War on Two Fronts" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> as she believed him vital to helping secure Onderonian self-determination.<ref name=":1" /> She had a close bond to her [[Ruping/Legends|ruping]] mount, and it would plunge into danger to save its rider.<ref name="SWE-ruping">{{SWE|characters|ruping|ruping}}</ref> At some point, she wrote for ''[[The Daily Rebellion]]''.<ref name="TCWcomic646">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.46|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.46]]</ref>

====Help from the Republic====
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date" /> Gerrera was one of the insurgents who contacted the Jedi for help to overthrow their corrupt [[King/Legends|King]]. Upon [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] prompting, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] training team, consisting of Skywalker himself, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were sent to Onderon to train the rebels in fighting techniques.<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" />

Upon meeting the Jedi, Gerrera became acquainted with Tano, who was a close friend of [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], one of the co-leaders of the rebel forces. Gerrera had a silent crush on Bonteri. As a result, she reacted with barely veiled jealousy at Tano's closeness to Bonteri, and Tano in turn became painfully aware of Gerrera's attraction to Bonteri. During training, Gerrera profiled herself as a talented sharpshooter with precise accuracy.<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" />
[[File:RebelsInspectGenerator-FR.png|thumb|250x250px|Steela, Lux and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] operating on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].|left]]
As the Jedi and the resistance fighters were ready to attack the droids, they developed a plan to get inside the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. There, they disguised themselves as hunters in order to cross on weighing the security check at the gate unmolested. Inside the city, Steela and the group planned to split up and regroup after dark. In the evening Steela and the group met with the Jedi and her brother to discuss the situation in the rebel hideout of the city to discuss their plan in overthrowing the King. In order to win, Steela and the rebels planned to hijack a Separatist tank and use it to destroy the power facility which would cause a blackout. Steela was able to kill the droid leader until it sent out a distress signal. While Saw would blast the facility with his tank, Steela was tasked in eliminating the guard droids with her [[Avarik Armaments long rifle]] and gave her brother enough time to destroy the generator, allowing the rebels to destroy the remaining droids. During a subsequent celebration in the hideout, Steela was appointed as the new leader of the resistance group.<ref name="Front Runners">{{TCW|Front Runners}}</ref>

As [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] began to deploy more [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist reinforcements]] to support King [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], Steela led a small group of rebels to destroy all the droids and the tanks. After completing the mission, Steela was put on a roof and made a speech to the people of Iziz to not lose hope and to turn against King Rash, although, King Ramsis and the Separatists were able to identify her. In order to lure the rebels out of hiding, the king announced the execution of the former regent Dendup. Steela decided to wait for the time to rescue him at the day of the execution, but her brother went to the royal palace in an attempt to rescue the former king [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]]. He failed, however, he was captured and tortured by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]]. As [[Dono (Onderonian)/Legends|Dono]] witnessed his arrest, Steela refused to free her brother, but remained focused in rescuing Dendup from execution tomorrow,<ref name="The Soft War" /> the kind of hard decision that leaders had to make.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>

The next day, Steela led a squad and nearly succeeded in rescuing the former King, but they were quickly overwhelmed and surrounded by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Since her brother was able to convince General [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]] of what the Separatists had done, he betrayed Rash and freed Steela and the rebels from near-execution with all the palace guards by the general's side.<ref name="The Soft War">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref>

====Heroic death====
[[File:Steela_dies_on_Onderon.jpg|thumb|250x250px|Steela after her deadly fall.]]
The Rebels, having rescued their king, set up a base in the highlands to hide from the droids. However, Kalani, having acquired [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP]] Gunships, launched a vicious assault on the rebels to kill King Dendup. They were saved in the nick of time by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], who brought a 'gift' of Sienar rocket launchers, which [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had paid him to deliver. With the rocket launchers, the rebels began to gain ground against the droid forces. The last gunship was shot down by Steela's brother [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]]. Unfortunately, it crashed near Steela and sent her off a cliff, though she managed to grab a ledge. [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] attempted to rescue her, but almost fell over himself. [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] managed to use the Force to lift him to safety and was lifting Steela as the wrecked gunship shot her in the shoulder, causing her to drop Steela. She died from fall trauma.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref>

===Legacy===
[[File:DendupSpeech-TippingPoints.png|thumb|250x250px|The [[Funeral of Steela Gerrera/Legends|funeral of Steela Gerrera]].|left]]
A [[Funeral of Steela Gerrera/Legends|funeral]] was later held in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] to honor her. Because of Gerrera's heroics, the King and people of Onderon would remember her as a martyr who saved their world from the tyranny of the Separatists.<ref name=":0" />

Even after the death Steela remained a rallying figure for the people of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], who remained part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] until its fall.<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date" />

==Personality and traits==
Not as boisterous or as outspoken as her brother, Steela Gerrera was nonetheless firmly dedicated to the cause of Onderonian independence. She was not one for impassioned speeches or political rhetoric. These were not her areas of expertise, and she felt far more comfortable peering through the macroscope of her blaster rifle. A crack shot, Steela racked up an impressive number of droid kills with precise headshots fired from the cover of canopy jungle.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> A driven rebel soldier of intense focus, Steela hide self doubt behind her icy stare of determination.<ref name=":5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character Steela Gerrera was created by [[George Lucas]]. Lucas had already created Saw, her brother, and wanted to involve and tell more about that character, resulting in Steela. The people behind the show also wanted a brother/sister duo on Onderon. Steela would also act as a natural foil to Ahsoka Tano.<ref>
{{SW|url=news/interview-dave-filoni-on-star-wars-the-clone-wars-season-five-part-1|text=Interview: Dave Filoni on ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season Five, Part 1}}</ref>

The character was voiced by [[Dawn-Lyen Gardner]].<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" />
